text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, geez……!
That's not nearly enough……!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer.
I messed up again today."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Even though you worked so hard to put together a plan for me, Trainer... I still couldn't reach it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
With a result like this, I ended up letting down
both your expectations and my own...
choice_data_list: Don't beat yourself up over it.
Don't brood over it too much.
You're fine just the way you are!
You're fine just the way you are!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. That's true.
If Palmer-san is down in the dumps,
it'd trouble you too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Well, that's enough of being gloomy.
We've still got plenty of energy left.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because... I haven't forgotten
the thrill of running freely in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...! Right.
What was I even saying...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I'm truly sorry.
I almost forgot what you taught me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's way, way worse than losing,
isn't it...? That's just...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I'm good!
I won't hesitate anymore!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, I'll still...
aim for the top with my own running!
